englishTranscript: Chicken nuggets recipe. What type? Ah, nuggets. Ok. Take 1/2 kg boneless chicken. Cut it into small pieces and mince it. Then inside it, add 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp peri peri masala, and what else was added? Speak slowly and gently. Pass it. Yeah. Uh, 1/2 tsp black pepper powder and 1/2 tsp or slightly more than 1/2 tsp red chili powder and salt slightly less than 1/2 tsp or 1/2 tsp salt. When you make the mince of chicken, after that in this garlic powder, red chili powder, black pepper powder, salt, and this peri peri masala and 1/4 tsp mixed herbs or oregano add it and mix it completely. This is your recipe. After that to make cutlets, these nuggets, give it a shape and in one egg add salt and black pepper and beat it. In that, the nuggets shape that is given, dip it and coat it in bread crumb and you can deep fry it or shallow fry it. Nuggets recipe is this much.
name: Chicken Nuggets
description: Homemade chicken nuggets made with minced boneless chicken, seasoned with garlic powder, peri-peri masala, black pepper, red chili, and herbs, then coated in egg and bread crumbs to be fried.

ingredients.name: boneless chicken, cut into small pieces and minced
salt and black pepper (for the egg wash)

steps.text: Mince the boneless chicken after cutting it into small pieces.
Add garlic powder, peri peri masala, black pepper powder, red chili powder, salt, mixed herbs or oregano to the minced chicken and mix thoroughly.
In a separate bowl, beat an egg with a little salt and black pepper.
Dip the shaped nuggets into the beaten egg, then coat them in bread crumbs.
Fry the nuggets by deep frying or shallow frying.
